text: One of the few remaining enchantment tables lies here in the academy of Grenmark.
zh: 现存为数不多的附魔台之一，就安放在格伦马克的学院里。

text: Most were destroyed during the Crownless Years, which is why enchantment knowledge is so rare.
zh: 大多数附魔台都毁于无冠之年，附魔知识因此变得如此稀有。

text: Apparently, it requires three items to be placed on the table. However, the choice of items is important, as only certain combinations seem to work.
zh: 使用时显然需要在台上放置三件物品。不过物品的选择很关键，似乎只有特定的组合才会起效。

text: I've successfully conducted basic enchantments using small gems.
zh: 我已成功用小宝石完成了基础附魔。

text: For example, placing three small gems of the same color causes them to fuse into a larger one.
zh: 例如，放上三颗同色的小宝石，它们便会熔合成一颗更大的宝石。

text: Combining gems of different colors may be possible, though I've yet to test that hypothesis.
zh: 组合不同颜色的宝石或许也可行，不过这个假设我尚未验证。

text: Apparently, the rare blood gems react strongly with certain equipment. I wonder what effect they have.
zh: 稀有的血宝石显然会与某些装备产生强烈反应。我很好奇它们究竟有何效果。
